# API method index

> Alphabetical index of every API method and the client functions.

Every InnBucks Merchant API method, in alphabetical order.

| Method | HTTP | Path | Success | Reference | Guide |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Account statement | `POST` | `/api/account/fullStatement` | `00` | [7.11](api-reference.md#711-account-statement) | [12.6](best-practices.md#126-reconciliation) |
| Bank change | `POST` | `/api/transaction/bankChange` | `00` | [7.9](api-reference.md#79-bank-change) | [6.5](agent-services.md#65-bank-change) |
| Code inquiry | `POST` | `/api/code/inquiry` | `00` + `status` | [7.4](api-reference.md#74-code-inquiry) | [5.4](payments.md#54-check-the-status) |
| Deposit | `POST` | `/api/transaction/deposit` | `00` | [7.6](api-reference.md#76-deposit) | [6.2](agent-services.md#62-cash-deposit-cash-in) |
| Deposit inquiry | `POST` | `/bank/api/transaction/inquiry` | `00` + `details.responseCode` | [7.7](api-reference.md#77-deposit-inquiry) | [6.3](agent-services.md#63-when-a-deposit-result-is-lost-deposit-inquiry) |
| Generate code (payment) | `POST` | `/api/code/generate` | `00` | [7.3](api-reference.md#73-generate-code) | [5.1](payments.md#51-generate-a-payment-code) |
| Generate code (withdrawal) | `POST` | `/api/code/generate` | `00` | [7.3](api-reference.md#73-generate-code) | [6.1](agent-services.md#61-cash-withdrawal-cash-out) |
| Linked account inquiry | `GET` | `/api/v1/account/msisdn/{msisdn}/details` | `000` | [7.5](api-reference.md#75-linked-account-inquiry) | [6.2](agent-services.md#62-cash-deposit-cash-in) |
| Login | `POST` | `/auth/third-party` | `00` + `accessToken` | [7.2](api-reference.md#72-login) | [4.1](authentication.md#41-log-in) |
| Response code list | `GET` | `/api/file/response-codes` | `2xx` | [7.12](api-reference.md#712-response-code-list) | [8.2](errors-and-retries.md#82-response-codes) |
| Reversal (deposits only) | `POST` | `/api/transaction/reversal/v2` | `00` | [7.8](api-reference.md#78-reversal) | [6.4](agent-services.md#64-reversing-a-deposit) |
| Utility payment | `POST` | `/api/utility/provider/payment` | `00` | [7.10](api-reference.md#710-utility-payment) | [7.10](api-reference.md#710-utility-payment) |

And the deep link, which is not an API call:

| | Format |
|---|---|
| Test | `zw.co.innbucksnova.test://purchase?paymentToken={code}` |
| Production | `com.innbucks.customer://purchase?paymentToken={code}` |

The client methods for each language:

| API method | PHP / Laravel | Node.js | Python |
|---|---|---|---|
| Login | `token()` | `login()` | `login()` |
| Generate code | `generateCode()` | `generateCode()` | `generate_code()` |
| Code inquiry | `inquireCode()` | `inquireCode()` | `inquire_code()` |
| Linked account inquiry | `linkedAccount()` | `linkedAccount()` | `linked_account()` |
| Deposit | `deposit()` | `deposit()` | `deposit()` |
| Deposit inquiry | `depositInquiry()` | `depositInquiry()` | `deposit_inquiry()` |
| Reversal | `reverseDeposit()` | `reverseDeposit()` | `reverse_deposit()` |
| Bank change | `bankChange()` | `bankChange()` | `bank_change()` |
| Utility payment | `utilityPayment()` | `utilityPayment()` | `utility_payment()` |
| Account statement | `statement()` | `statement()` | `statement()` |
| *(helper)* deep link | `deepLink()` | `deepLink()` | `deep_link()` |
| *(helper)* wait for a code | `PollInnBucksCode` job | `waitForCode()` | `wait_for_code()` |
